g.text: Comparing relative and conventional tropical Pacific SST indices

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657587

g.text: RONI and ONI are overlapping three-month means, aligned by central month. The difference is RONI minus ONI.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657587

g.text: RONI uses a relative tropical-ocean SST baseline and variance adjustment; ONI uses centered 30-year climatologies.
